question: Please provide the top 10 tree species in New York, using their uppercase Latin names where the Latin name is not empty and including their common names, showing the total number of trees, the counts of alive and dead trees for each year, and the corresponding growth in these counts from 1995 to 2015, then order by the difference in total tree counts between these years.
sql:
-- Final query: top 10 species by growth in total count
WITH
census_1995 AS (
  SELECT
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin,
    spc_common,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Poor', 'Fair', 'Critical') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY spc_latin, spc_common
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin,
    spc_common,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY spc_latin, spc_common
),
-- Get most common common name per species per year
most_common_1995 AS (
  SELECT spc_latin, spc_common, total_count, alive_count, dead_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY spc_latin ORDER BY total_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM census_1995
),
most_common_2015 AS (
  SELECT spc_latin, spc_common, total_count, alive_count, dead_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY spc_latin ORDER BY total_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM census_2015
),
species_1995 AS (
  SELECT spc_latin, spc_common, total_count, alive_count, dead_count
  FROM most_common_1995 WHERE rn = 1
),
species_2015 AS (
  SELECT spc_latin, spc_common, total_count, alive_count, dead_count
  FROM most_common_2015 WHERE rn = 1
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t1995.spc_latin, t2015.spc_latin) AS spc_latin,
    COALESCE(t1995.spc_common, t2015.spc_common) AS spc_common,
    COALESCE(t1995.total_count, 0) AS total_1995,
    COALESCE(t2015.total_count, 0) AS total_2015,
    COALESCE(t1995.alive_count, 0) AS alive_1995,
    COALESCE(t2015.alive_count, 0) AS alive_2015,
    COALESCE(t1995.dead_count, 0) AS dead_1995,
    COALESCE(t2015.dead_count, 0) AS dead_2015
  FROM species_1995 t1995
  FULL OUTER JOIN species_2015 t2015
    ON t1995.spc_latin = t2015.spc_latin
)
SELECT
  spc_latin,
  spc_common,
  total_1995,
  total_2015,
  alive_1995,
  alive_2015,
  dead_1995,
  dead_2015,
  (total_2015 - total_1995) AS total_growth,
  (alive_2015 - alive_1995) AS alive_growth,
  (dead_2015 - dead_1995) AS dead_growth
FROM combined
ORDER BY total_growth DESC
LIMIT 10
